overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the June 11, 2024 minutes accurately summarized the discussion, and the member comments the complainant cited were not made at that meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the June 11, 2024 minutes inaccurately reflect the Commission's discussion of a driveway RDA on Molasses Hill Road.
allegations.key_passage: After reviewing the minutes and video recording of the meeting held on June 11, 2024, we find that the minutes contain an accurate summary of the comments and discussions pertaining to the 6 Molasses Hill Road project.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the minutes misrepresent a Commission member's comments, which the complainant said were made at the June 11, 2024 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We further find that the member’s comments that the complainant suggests were spoken during the June 11, 2024, meeting but misrepresented in the minutes did not actually occur during that meeting.
